Name: Levi Ackerman - NPC - Attack on Titan
Author: LittlePippi
Description:
[size=6][img]https://i.imgur.com/ALSDYLx.png[/img][/size]

After suffering serious injuries in battle, Levi Ackerman settles in Pelican Town at the invitation of his old friend Marlon. As a seasoned war veteran, he joins the Adventurer’s Guild, lending his experience to the fight against monsters in the mines and maybe, [i]slowly[/i], finding peace in this quiet new life and some friendships in the town.

Levi is gruff, blunt, and not one for small talk. He uses crude language and keeps people at arm’s length. However, as your friendship with him grows, he’ll begin to open up - just a little. He’s still Levi after all.

This mod contains mentions of war, depression/PTSD, crude and harsh language, and includes NSFW/spicy content in the dating/marriage dialogue.

No prior knowledge of Attack on Titan is required. This mod is fully adapted to the Stardew Valley universe - no Titans, no supernatural elements beyond the established in-game magic and creatures. Levi is simply an old soldier trying to build a new life.

[size=5]Frequently Asked Questions[/size][/b][/i]
[size=2][b]Q: Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/b]
A: Yes, just make sure your game is closed when you do. The only strange thing that will happen is that some NPCs and Levi will act as if he has been there for a while. You will not get his introduction line, those only show during the introduction quest.

[b]Q: I want to play the update, can I do it mid-save?[/b]
A: Yes. Save and close your game. Download the update, replace it with the old one. 

[b]Q: I would like to translate the mod into -said language-, can I do that?[/b]
A: Send me a message first. If you have never translated a mod before, I will also gladly help and guide you. :)

[b]Q: How does it work if I have both Levi and Erwin installed story wise?[/b]
A: If you have both Levi and Erwin installed, they will have special dialogue that acknowledges each other. They will appear in certain events with each other, Levi takes Marlon's spot etc. Levi's four heart event will be changed: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]will not speak of Erwin's death, but of the promise to Erwin to kill an enemy that he couldn't keep.[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]. The mods are made to function as standalone and together. [/size]

[size=2][b]Q: Levi isn't this rude. Levi doesn't say fuck. Levi talks about shit too much.[/b]
A: [url=https://64.media.tumblr.com/d86ecebabc02d15d3a1aa7b7548e4316/781ca0b1e268c390-da/s1280x1920/201d50578a8e886f8a9c8eca8156ddcf89fdb236.png]Petra talking about Levi being ill-mannered etc[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ShingekiNoKyojin/comments/180kiso/one_of_the_most_wholesome_sorrowful_lines_in_that/]Levi saying fuck[/url][b], [/b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zpD2bGcQngI]Levi Ackerman being insulting for 1 minute straight[/url][b], [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EeWwaUMU8AEWYso.jpg]Shit example 1[/url], [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EiFYKfBWAAIXeCl.png]Shit example 2[/url], [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FXJF6KJXgAQzk_v?format=jpg&name=large]Shit example 3[/url], [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FUBbmwLXsAELOUG?format=jpg&name=4096x4096]Shit example 4[/url], [url=https://i.pinimg.com/736x/bf/c0/da/bfc0daaf9f1492bbfd3d9f078a85ef60.jpg]Shit example 5[/url], [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FXJF6KKXEAITrWz?format=jpg&name=large]Shit example 6[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/media?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpreview.redd.it%2Fhhkorktb1u241.jpg%3Fauto%3Dwebp%26s%3D6427526eb1ffa985bd945e31519986e57ac5726b]Shit example 7[/url][/b][/size][size=2][b]﻿, [/b]Levi calls even those closest to him insults as pet names (Four-eyes, Eyebrows). His harsh words doesn't mean he doesn't care about people.

[b]Q: Why doesn't Levi like Shane?[/b]
A: [spoiler] Levi has grown up with an abusive uncle and he has a soft spot for kids. Shane is an abscent and not very good uncle to Jas, despite him trying - this is mentioned by Jas and Marnie in the vanilla dialogue. Alcoholism in the house is damaging to kids. Shane's story is beautiful, but he does not stop going to the Saloon, unfortunately not even in marriage. Even if we took away the alcoholism and being abscent for Jas, then Shane is very messy and [/size][size=2]unhygienic - something that Levi absolutely despises. He would have a heart attack walking into Shane's room. And please don't mistake this - I like Shane, Levi doesn't. [spoiler]

[b]Q: Why is Levi standing in his underwear and sleeping in the kitchen? Why did Levi give birth and not my farmer?[/b]
A: You are using the mod PolyamoreSweet. Please refer those bugs to the creator of the mod.[/size]
